definitions.title: PHP2Shell exposure assessment
definitions.description: Potential PHP2Shell exposure inferred only from an exposed PHP version. These CVE identifiers and version thresholds are user-supplied and have not been independently verified. A banner does not establish exploitability, configuration, or vendor backport status.
definitions.remediation: Verify the advisory and package status with the vendor. Upgrade PHP to a patched release supported by the vendor; restrict unnecessary web exposure.
definitions.provenance: User-supplied PHP2Shell cases; public CVEProject records returned 404 on 2026-10-22. Thresholds are provisional, not vendor-confirmed.
